budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Three real child roots, 21 D2/E1 seams and four-stage regional resets. New SQ/VC command and return landings add four feedback edges. Each root owns local landing cells in a source-pinned placement band, with canonical physical child-centre clock taps. No child RTL or timing-limit change. Full programme proof required before physical gate.
